If the format-conversion flag this[1042] (byte 0x1048) is set, first remaps the vertex buffer through DirectXVertexBufferFormatConversion; computes a source pointer from this[11] (byte 0x2C) indexed by the a2/a3 block coordinates, calls UtilityFunction_7473, then loops over this[1046] (byte 0x1058) samples with a 16-byte stride writing 16-bit words and returning dword_8B009C.
